name: codex-prewalk
description: Prewalk-style planner-to-executor trajectory handoff for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with Sol, execute with Luna
interface.longDescription: Runs a coding task on a stronger planner until its plan is ready and the first successful edit lands, then interrupts that turn and continues the same Codex thread on a faster executor model.
defaultPrompt: Use Prewalk to implement this task
Prewalk this fix with Sol then Luna
